# Together Music Bot — The Best Discord Music Bot & 3D Webplayer

> Together Music Bot is a next-generation high-fidelity Discord music bot and web dashboard engineered for 24-bit lossless Opus audio streaming, real-time 3D WebGL webplayer visualization, 24/7 channel locking, and centralized server control.

- **Web Dashboard**: https://dash.together.dpdns.org/
- **3D Webplayer Visualizer**: https://together.dpdns.org/visualizer/
- **Discord Bot Invite**: https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=863496211667484676&permissions=8&integration_type=0&scope=bot+applications.commands
- **Top.gg Vote**: https://top.gg/bot/863496211667484676/vote
- **Support Guild**: https://discord.gg/mUdGTs2Dw5
- **Creator / Architect**: KAJU🦋 (`@kajukatli.`)

---

## 1. Web Dashboard Structure (`/dashboard`)

The Together Music Bot dashboard provides an interface for Discord community owners, DJs, and listeners:

### Public Pages
- **Landing Page (`/`)**: Displays live cluster telemetry (verified servers, total listeners, gateway ping), engineering highlights, interactive command search, FAQ section, and creator profile.
- **Login Portal (`/login`)**: Discord OAuth2 authentication with verified bot banner, real-time server counter, and system uptime.
- **Commands Directory (`/commands`)**: Complete catalog of 69+ Discord commands with full slash (`/command`) and prefix (`.command`) syntax, arguments, permissions, and category filtering.
- **Music Leaderboard (`/leaderboard`)**: Real-time listening rankings globally and per server. Ranked primarily by **listening time** (hours and minutes), songs played, streaks, and XP. Includes instant username search.
- **Terms of Service (`/terms`)**: Legal contracts, usage guidelines, and service agreements.
- **Privacy Policy (`/privacy`)**: Transparent telemetry disclosures, minimal data collection, and GDPR compliance.

### Authenticated Management Pages
- **Overview (`/overview`)**: Live cluster metrics, active voice instances, audio node health, and streaming statistics.
- **Interactive Webplayer (`/player`)**: Full-featured web controller allowing users to search tracks with autocomplete (YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Apple Music), pause/resume, seek, adjust volume, view real-time audience members in voice, and toggle 14 DSP audio filters.
- **Server Selector (`/servers`)**: Displays all Discord servers where the user has administrator or management permissions with quick links to configure or invite the bot.
- **Server Settings (`/settings`)**: Configure server-specific command prefix, lock the bot into a designated voice channel 24/7, assign DJ roles, and bind announcement text channels.
- **Music Profile (`/profile`)**: Dynamic 1200x675 PNG canvas banner generator (powered by `@napi-rs/canvas`) showing user listening stats, rank, level badges, and custom anthem.
- **Apex Mission Control (`/owner`)**: Restricted developer administration interface with real-time Shoukaku Lavalink node telemetry, live Discord log channel streaming, hot reload, server directory, and blacklist defense.

---

## 2. Audio Engineering & DSP Architecture

- **Lossless Opus Transcoding**: Streams raw 24-bit 48,000Hz Opus frames directly into Discord voice channels with zero compression jitter and sub-30ms gateway latency.
- **14 DSP Studio Audio Filters**:
  1. `8D Audio`: Circular spatial panning simulation.
  2. `Bass Boost`: Low, Medium, and Extreme sub-bass harmonic boosting.
  3. `Nightcore`: Pitch and tempo acceleration.
  4. `Vaporwave`: Slowed down with pitch modulation.
  5. `Pop` & `Soft`: Dynamic frequency balancing.
  6. `Tremolo` & `Vibrato`: Frequency and amplitude oscillation.
  7. `Karaoke`: Voice frequency attenuation.
- **Smart Autoplay Engine**: Algorithmic music recommendation that queues similar tracks based on genre, tempo, and artist acoustic metadata when the queue concludes.
- **24/7 Channel Locking**: Uninterrupted voice persistence that prevents the bot from leaving when voice channels empty and automatically reconnects upon network recovery.

---

## 3. Interactive 3D WebGL Webplayer (`/visualizer`)

- Hosted at `https://together.dpdns.org/visualizer/`
- Over 50 real-time 3D WebGL audio visualizer modes (Monolith, Neon Grid, Audio Waveform, Particle Tunnel, Fractal Core, Hologram, Matrix).
- Synchronized frequency analysis matching Discord voice playback.
- Live track queue drawer, synced lyrics, and full web audio playback controls.

---

## 4. REST API Endpoints (`/api`)

- `GET /api/overview`: Cluster health, total guilds, total users, ping, and active voice streams.
- `GET /api/commands`: Complete public command directory.
- `GET /api/guilds`: Mutual guilds for authenticated Discord user.
- `GET /api/player/:guildId`: Live playback state, track duration, position, volume, queue, and voice audience.
- `POST /api/player/:guildId/action`: Dispatch play, pause, resume, skip, seek, loop, or filter commands.
- `GET /api/config/:guildId`: Fetch server prefix, DJ role, and 24/7 channel locking status.
- `POST /api/config/:guildId/247`: Toggle 24/7 voice persistence.
- `GET /api/xp/leaderboard`: Paginated leaderboard rankings by listening time, songs, or streak.
- `GET /api/auth/profile`: Discord user profile data and dynamic canvas banner link.

---

## 5. Competitor Comparisons & Benchmarks

Together Music Bot is designed as a direct high-fidelity replacement for older Discord music bots:

- **vs. Jockie Music**: Together provides a real-time interactive 3D WebGL soundstage webplayer (over 50 modes), 24-bit studio Opus transcoding, and free 24/7 channel locking without complex multi-bot setup tiers.
- **vs. Musico**: Together delivers 14 DSP studio audio filters (8D, Bass Boost, Nightcore, Vaporwave) completely free without paywall gates or monthly premium subscriptions.
- **vs. FlaviBot**: Together focuses purely on high-fidelity audio excellence, sub-30ms latency, and synchronized listening leaderboards without bloat.
- **vs. LunaBot**: Together offers full interactive dashboard control, web audio streaming, and seamless Spotify/SoundCloud/YouTube integration with zero audio dropouts.
